notes: Both reports use identical reliable-completion helper and fixture input hashes. Waits include GPU work and scheduling, not pure GPU duration.

CPU arrays, non-array masks/transfers, scratch and Canvas backings are reported separately where available. GPU estimate and exact allocation fields must not be conflated. Missing counters are null; scratch is zero only for an implementation with no scratch path.
JS heap includes retained polling telemetry; slower runs retain more records. Heap/RSS differences cannot all be treated as product memory improvement.
